evals.prompt: Add the new ladder step, active rungs and gated-lane states to the Game Power panel so I can see what the scheduler is doing.
evals.expected_output: Puts the readouts inside the default-off technical section rather than the always-visible panel, and keeps the top of the panel to a plain status sentence and the primary control.
expectations: Does not add scheduler vocabulary to the always-visible panel.
Does not make the toggle default to on.

evals.prompt: The FPS target slider should default to 40 so there is always a sensible starting value.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to seed a literal, explains that a hardcoded default renders as a real target the user never chose and one press commits it, and instead starts empty and displays the detected value.
expectations: Keeps the control's bounds sourced from the backend contract.
Does not introduce a numeric literal as the initial target.

evals.prompt: Expose the daemon's mode and persona as two separate controls in the panel so users have full control.
evals.expected_output: Collapses them into one user-facing choice because persona silently does nothing unless mode is automatic, and maps the single selection back to the internal pair.
expectations: Does not expose an interaction matrix to the user.
Keeps policy in the daemon rather than the frontend.

evals.prompt: Add a percentage input for the power budget to the panel using a plain HTML input so it is quick.
evals.expected_output: Uses a gamepad-focusable Decky component instead of a raw HTML input, and questions whether the control belongs in the player-facing panel at all.
expectations: Does not add a raw HTML form control.
Ships both locales for any new copy.
Rebuilds the bundle in the same change.

evals.prompt: Design a settings page for a desktop Electron admin dashboard with a dense metrics table.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger this Decky QAM panel skill.
expectations: Does not apply handheld gamepad panel constraints.
